Inline comments: In `@docs/AI_HANDOFF.md`: - Line 42: Update the commit list in AI_HANDOFF.md by replacing “(este commit)” with the actual SHA for the documentation change, while retaining the English “docs: require feature-branch PRs instead of pushing main” message and the existing commit entries. In `@docs/GIT_PR_WORKFLOW.md`: - Line 38: Update the direct-push exception in the Git PR workflow guidance so pushing to main is permitted only when the user explicitly requests it; otherwise, keep the instruction requiring a pull request. In `@qa/check_roundtrip.py`: - Line 64: Update the roundtrip validation around base_rev to inspect the source revision kinds and require w:ins when insert revisions exist and w:del when delete revisions exist, rather than checking only for w:ins whenever any revision is present. In `@src/core/Docx.cpp`: - Around line 121-128: Update cross-reference generation around insert_crossref and bookmarksAroundWml to precompute synthetic bookmarks for referenced block IDs when no explicit Bookmark exists, then wrap each corresponding target block with that bookmark so REF and PAGEREF fields resolve correctly. - Line 487: Move the contentTypes construction currently formatted before the note handling so it occurs after both the footnote and endnote branches that update extraTypes. Ensure the final package content types include overrides added by both note branches, while preserving the existing formatting and output behavior. - Around line 959-963: Update the duplicate detection around the revision check to assign the current block before comparison, then include blockId alongside kind, start, and end when determining duplicates. Ensure revisions from different paragraphs are retained even when their offsets match. - Around line 845-846: Update saveDocx/import bookmark handling around hasBookmarkNamed so metadata bookmarks are matched using the same normalized native names written to document.xml, rather than only their original aioffice.json names and IDs. Recreate the export-name mapping before native bookmark import, or persist and reuse that mapping in aioffice.json, while preserving existing duplicate-prevention behavior. --- Outside diff comments: In `@src/core/Session.cpp`: - Line 1487: Update the revision handling around revisionReject and revisionRejectAll to capture the character text being removed before calling spliceRuns, then assign that captured text to rev.text instead of using "?". Preserve the restored deleted character when either rejection path reinserts the revision. ```
